entities.text: Indukuri Pandu Ranga Raju vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.2985 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners No.1 and 2-Accused Nos.2 and 3 to quash the proceedings against them in respect of FIR No.12 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Shameerpet Police Station, Cyberabad, filed for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 468, 120B and 506 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.

3. On the basis of complaint of 2nd respondent - de facto complainant, the Sub-Inspector of Police,
Shameerpet Police Station, has registered the present crime.
The present complaint was referred by the learned Magistrate.
4. As seen from the complaint, there are transactions regarding sale of agricultural land.

Further,
there are allegations and counter allegations.

5. Keeping in view that the transactions pertain to sale of agricultural land which appears to be purely civil in nature, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Investigating Officer in respect of FIR No.12 of 2023 pending on the file of Station House Officer, Shameerpet Police Station,
Cyberabad, to conclude investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioners No.1 and 2-Accused Nos.2 and 3.

Further, the petitioners shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation and also give specimens of his handwriting, if required by the investigating agency.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
K.SURENDER, J Date: 21.04.2023 Note: Issue C.C. by Monday.
